subject: radiology
title: Radiosensitive Tumours, Chemoradiation and Palliative Radiotherapy

steps.title: Seminoma melts with radiation
steps.tx: **Radiosensitive tumours** led by seminoma and lymphoma shrink dramatically at doses other cancers laugh at, because their cells die in interphase and divide rapidly with poor repair. The pictured testicular germ cell set includes seminoma, whose stage one paraaortic relapse risk was historically managed with modest dose fields around twenty gray. Modern surveillance has replaced much of that prophylactic radiation, but the sensitivity ranking itself remains the examiners favourite list.

steps.title: The sensitivity ladder
steps.tx: **Radiocurability ranking** runs seminoma and lymphoma most sensitive, then neuroblastoma and Wilms, myeloma intermediate, epithelial cancers of cervix, head and neck and skin in the middle, and melanoma, osteosarcoma, glioblastoma and renal cell traditionally resistant at standard doses. Resistant never means radiation proof: high dose stereotaxis controls renal and melanoma metastases that shrug at conventional fractions, rewriting several rungs of the classic ladder in modern practice.

steps.title: Specimen and marker partners
steps.tx: **Seminoma specimen** in the pictured gross set shows the creamy homogeneous cut surface that matches its uniform radiosensitive biology, while its markers stay nearly silent: human chorionic gonadotropin mildly raised in a minority, alpha fetoprotein never raised by pure seminoma, lactate dehydrogenase tracking burden. Those marker rules matter because a raised alpha fetoprotein reclassifies the tumour as nonseminomatous and reroutes chemotherapy and surgery decisions entirely.

steps.title: Cisplatin radiosensitises cervix and head neck
steps.tx: **Concurrent chemoradiation** pairs weekly cisplatin with pelvic radiotherapy in locally advanced cervix cancer and with head and neck fields in unresectable or organ preservation disease, because platinum crosslinks disable the repair of radiation breaks in the same cells. The combination buys survival at the cost of nausea, kidney and marrow reserve, so fitness for cisplatin is assessed as carefully as the tumour stage. Brachytherapy remains non negotiable in cervix, external beam alone never substitutes.

The combination buys survival at real toxicity cost, so cisplatin fitness is assessed as carefully as stage. Brachytherapy remains non negotiable in cervix cancer.

steps.title: Radical versus palliative intent
steps.tx: **Palliative radiotherapy** trades duration for speed: single 8 gray fractions relieve bone metastasis pain as well as long courses in most patients, with response over two to four weeks in about sixty percent. Radical courses instead spend six to seven weeks chasing cure where microscopic spread patterns allow. Cord compression, bleeding tumours and superior vena cava obstruction sit between, urgent palliative problems where steroids, stents and radiation are sequenced by neurology and airway, not by habit.

steps.title: Whole brain and bone protocols
steps.tx: **Whole brain radiotherapy** historically treated multiple brain metastases at thirty gray in ten fractions, now displaced for limited deposits by stereotactic radiosurgery that spares cognition, with hippocampal avoidance and memantine softening whole brain when diffuse disease still needs it. Bone metastases answer single fractions except where cord, weight bearing stability or re treatment fields complicate. The modern desk skill is choosing the shortest effective course per patient, not the longest available.

steps.title: Head neck organ preservation
steps.tx: **Organ preservation** chemoradiation keeps the larynx in advanced laryngeal and hypopharyngeal cancer with survival equal to primary laryngectomy in selected patients, trading the voice box for mucositis, feeding tubes and hypothyroid surveillance. Human papillomavirus positive oropharynx cancers respond so well that de escalation trials test lower doses, while HPV negative smokers tumours keep full intensity. Salvage surgery after failed chemoradiation is harder and leakier, a consent point patients must hear upfront.

steps.title: Lymphoma fields shrink safely
steps.tx: **Lymphoma radiotherapy** shrank from extended fields bathing whole nodal chains to involved node and involved site fields of twenty to thirty gray, because chemotherapy carries the systemic load and late second malignancy plus cardiac dose haunted the old generous fields. Hodgkin lymphoma in young women drove that evolution, breast and thyroid late effects being unacceptable prices for already high cure rates. Sensitivity made lymphoma curable; restraint made the cure survivable.
steps.say: Lymphoma radiotherapy shrank from extended fields to involved site fields of twenty to thirty gray, because chemotherapy carries the systemic load and late second malignancy haunted generous fields. Sensitivity made lymphoma curable; restraint made the cure survivable, especially in young women.
